## 🧩 ROS1 Code Review Checklist

**Branch:**
> Please follow naming convention: `feature/<name>` or `fix/<name>`

---

### ✅ General
- [ ] Code follows `.clang-format`
- [ ] No compiler warnings or unused variables
- [ ] No hardcoded absolute paths
- [ ] File names follow `snake_case`
- [ ] Launch/YAML files load correctly

---

### 📄 Documentation
- [ ] Comments explain intent
- [ ] README or module doc updated (if new features added)
- [ ] No leftover `TODO`, `FIXME`, or debug print statements
- [ ] Code comments explain intent, not just mechanics

---

**Reviewer Notes**
> _Add feedback or approval summary here._
